meta.title: Bids well before the last minute do not move the end time
gaps: The setup and vocabulary support only two QA vendors, so the third vendor bid is not covered.
The available tokens do not permit comparing the final ending_at with the value read before bidding, so unchanged end time is not directly asserted.
The exact first-minute timing is not asserted; the bids are submitted immediately without a clock operation.

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for about 20 minutes.
steps: The buyer reads the pricing round.
The buyer invites QA vendor 2 to the live pricing round.
The invited QA vendor places a complete bid of 10 (open, price, submit).
A second QA vendor places a complete bid of 11 (open, price, submit).
As the buyer, read the pricing round and check that Data check: “bid count” equals 2; Schema check: “ending at” is a number.
words.expected: The app accepts it. Read back afterwards: Data check: “bid count” equals 2; Schema check: “ending at” is a number.
